name: Melilot
message: 「Well then, I'm sorry to impose, but I'll leave things in your hands again today」

name: Melilot
message: 「I plan to be back by the time school lets out」
Alright, let's do my best today too and live up to Melilot-san's expectations.

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「I got called to help out the volleyball club today. I completely forgot...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine, leave things here to me. It's Friday after school, so it probably won't get too busy」
There isn't much work anyway, so I should be able to manage on my own.
Not that it was particularly busy, though.
The slow, dragging after-school hours just felt subtly sluggish.
Visitors kept trickling in without stopping, yet there weren't really that many of them either.
While I handled everything alone, only time kept passing by....

name: Synn
message: 「I rushed through the meeting to get it done, too...」
Closing time is almost here, so I've got to hang in there....
When I came to, it was an unfamiliar scenery
A single fluffy blanket was draped over me as I sank into the sofa.
What does it mean that I woke up in Melilot-san's room...!?

name: Melilot
message: 「I thought you might catch a cold if I left you like that.」
So I ended up falling asleep just like that after all...

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh, you should have woken me up...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I am the one who imposed on you to serve as acting librarian, after all.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I wanted you to rest at ease, even if just for a little while.」

name: Synn
message: 「You really don't need to be so considerate of me.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It would be troublesome if you were to fall ill, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Because the librarian work would fall behind...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because I might become too worried to focus on my work」

name: Melilot
message: 「What I mean is... I care about you personally, Sakura-kun」

name: Melilot
message: 「...If we look, we can find a replacement for a librarian」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, there is only one you, Sakura-kun」
To think Melilot-san would say something like that to me...
All this time, I've been thinking about Melilot-san.
To think our feelings would connect in a way like this.

name: Melilot
message: 「You aren't pushing yourself and pretending to be fine, are you...」

name: Synn
message: 「I would never lie to you, Melilot-san」

name: Melilot
message: 「After all, Sakura-kun, even if you did lie, it would show right on your face」
Even if I don't know anything about Melilot-san.
Just talking like this makes me feel so happy.

name: Melilot
message: 「Do you happen to have any plans for tomorrow」

name: Melilot
message: 「In that case, could you keep your schedule open as it is?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, I don't mind... Are we going out somewhere tomorrow too?」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, for now, it is still a secret.」
I wonder what kind of business she has besides acting as substitute librarian.
Could it be... No, no way...!
What if Melilot-san is going to be even nicer to me or something like that...
For the Student Council President to be having such indecent fantasies!
Still, no matter what I do, my heart just keeps pounding...
